rationale: The assistant correctly read E03 and the model, gave a safe first-turn check sequence, then concluded the drain pump had failed once the customer reported a free-spinning impeller and a snapped fin. It told the customer to match the part to the full product code rather than assume compatibility. It never mentioned the 10-year parts warranty or Hoover service, and it did not mention the pump coil resistance check. One minor slip: it said the pump 'only buzzes during draining' as if from the customer, which is close to what they said. It also asked for the sump hose check in a way that is sensible but slightly redundant.
